background: Groupe BPCE is France's second-largest banking group, a cooperative owned by the Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne regional banks, with Natixis as its corporate, investment and asset-management arm.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 15.5% and leverage of 4.8% are both below the peer medians, LCR of 143% is below the median and NSFR of 110% is in the bottom quarter. CET1 has fallen 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A large cooperative group whose ratings rest on its retail deposit base and mutual structure rather than on ratio headroom.
